entry: computer-bridge/client.mjs executeComputerTool (validation, linuxCaptureFallback, linuxComputerPreflight, the dispatch and the fallback note), over linux-readiness.mjs probing its own machine (process.env, fs.accessSync/existsSync, child_process.spawn gdbus/gsettings, Date.now); detectSession, detectDesktop; linux-action-capabilities.mjs requiredCapabilities

exclusions.bridge: the desktop bridge is a stand-in HTTP endpoint (fetch) that records the dispatched command and answers ok: the helper and its screenshots are not run
exclusions.machine: the machine under the probes is virtual (environment, executables, writable and existing paths, gdbus/gsettings answers); the Rust side reads the same world through its process manager, where Node reads it through fs and spawn, so the shell checks Rust uses for PATH/uinput/files are answered from that world and only the gdbus/gsettings spawns are compared one to one
exclusions.notRecorded: the recording keeps no readiness object: a session is judged by what the tool returned and dispatched
exclusions.platform: process.platform is set to linux (or the named platform) for each case: the recorder runs on Windows

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
